name: United Kingdom
summary: United Kingdom is listed on the official registers as "United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland". This dossier records its status under five heritage-protection and international criminal law instruments, as shown on the UNESCO and United Nations Treaty Collection registers on 8 October 2026.

treaty_memberships.note: Also listed as a signatory on 30 December 1954.

Signed 30 Nov 1998. The UN Treaty Collection page attaches footnote 11 to the UK entry; it records UK communications (received 11 March 2010 and 28 November 2012) asking that the UK ratification be extended to listed territories for whose international relations the UK is responsible. See the footnote on the source page for the full list and text.
